name: Sweet
mentions: The Marquise, Wm. Van Driesche and hunting party consisting of Vic and Frank Smith, Tom Skinner and Sweet start this evening for Huntley, Mont. The horses have already been shipped there, this being the starting-point for the overland journey to the Big Horn. The party will…

…to start on another hunting expedition immediately, probably going into the Big Horn M't's. Tommy Skinner and Sweet will return to Medora with the stock. Altogether the trip according to William, was one extremely full of pleasure.
